name: nvm
label: nvm
description: Node.js versions from .nvmrc or .node-version, with corepack (pnpm, yarn).

tools.name: node
install: . "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" --no-use && nvm install "$1" </dev/null && PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which "$1")"):$PATH" corepack enable 2>/dev/null; true
list: . "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" --no-use && nvm ls-remote --no-colors </dev/null | grep -oE '^[ >-]*v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | tr -d ' >-' | sort -ruV | head -80

checks.name: nvm
argv: if . "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" --no-use >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "nvm not found (install it: https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm, or set NVM_DIR)" >&2; exit 1
